title: VICE PRESIDENT – KNITS PROCESSING
description:
To lead the techno-commercial operations of the knits processing division by driving business
  
  
growth, strengthening customer relationships, improving operational efficiency, and
  
  
expanding market presence across domestic and export segments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Marketing & Business Development**
Drive business development and customer acquisition in knit processing
  
  
Build strong networking and customer relationships in and around Tirupur
  
  
Handle key customer discussions, negotiations, and commercial activities
  
  
Develop and implement effective marketing strategies for business growth
  
  
**Operations & Production Management**
Oversee end-to-end processing operations and production performance
  
  
Ensure production planning, quality standards, and timely delivery
  
  
Improve operational efficiency, productivity, and process performance
  
  
Coordinate closely with production, quality, and commercial teams
  
  
**Techno-Commercial Leadership**
Manage commercial planning, costing, and profitability initiatives
  
  
Support pricing strategies and business expansion activities
  
  
Ensure smooth coordination between marketing, operations, and management
  
  
Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives
  
  
**Team & Customer Management**
Lead cross-functional teams across operations and marketing
  
  
Maintain strong customer satisfaction through service and quality excellence
  
  
Build long-term business relationships with buyers and exporters
  
  
**Key Skills Required**
Strong hands-on marketing skills in textile processing industry
  
  
Excellent networking capabilities in and around Tirupur textile market
  
  
Strong knowledge of knits processing operations and production management
  
  
Good exposure to business development and marketing strategies
  
  
Strong commercial, negotiation, and customer handling skills
  
  
Excellent leadership and team coordination abilities
  
  
**Experience Requirement**
Minimum 15-20 years of experience in textile processing industry
  
  
Strong exposure in knit processing, operations, and marketing functions
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience handling domestic and export customers preferred
  
  
Bachelor’s Degree in Textile / Engineering / Business / Commerce MBA preferred
  
  
Further Information, please Contact Mr.Saravanan, Mobile or WhatsApp no +91 638 374 3335 or Send resume at jobs@talentseeds.in

title: DISPATCH INCHARGE – E-COMMERCE, FBA & STOCK
description:
📢 \*\*WE’RE HIRING: DISPATCH INCHARGE – E\-COMMERCE, FBA \& STOCK
 





 \*\* 📍 \*\*Location:\*\* Tirupur, Tamil Nadu 🏢
 





 \*\*Company:\*\* Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 





 🏭 \*\*Industry:\*\* Apparel Manufacturing \| E\-commerce \| Retail
 





 💰 \*\*
 
**Salary:\*\* ₹18,000 – ₹30,000** 

 per month
 





 🧑‍💼 \*\*Experience:\*\* 2–7 Years
 





 We are looking for an organised and responsible
 
 ﻿
 
 \*\*Dispatch Incharge\*\* to independently handle our \*\*offline orders, bulk shipments, Amazon FBA shipments, marketplace dispatches and stock maintenance\*\*. The candidate should have strong warehouse coordination skills, accuracy in stock handling and the ability to ensure that every shipment leaves \*\*on time, in the correct quantity and with proper documentation\*\*. \#\#\# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \*\*
 





 1\. Daily Dispatch Management\*\*
 





 • Plan and supervise day\-to\-day dispatch activities
 





 • Ensure orders are picked, checked, packed and dispatched on time
 





 • Handle offline, wholesale, bulk and institutional orders
 





 • Coordinate courier, transport and logistics pickups
 





 • Verify quantity, SKU, size, colour and packing before dispatch
 





 • Ensure correct invoices, labels and shipment documents are attached
 





 • Maintain daily dispatch records and trackers
 





 • Follow up until shipments are handed over successfully
 





 \*\*2\. Amazon FBA \& Bulk Shipments\*\*
 





 • Prepare bulk inventory for Amazon FBA shipments
 





 • Coordinate FBA shipment quantities and SKU\-wise stock
 





 • Ensure correct product labelling, carton labelling and packing
 





 • Verify shipment plans against physically packed quantities
 





 • Prepare cartons according to marketplace requirements
 





 • Maintain carton\-wise and SKU\-wise shipment records
 





 • Coordinate transport / pickup for bulk FBA consignments
 





 • Track shipments until warehouse delivery
 





 • Identify shortages, discrepancies or rejected quantities and follow up for resolution
 





 \*\*3\. Marketplace Shipments\*\*
 





 Coordinate dispatch requirements for marketplaces including:
 





 • Amazon
 





 • Flipkart
 





 • Myntra
 





 • Meesho
 





 • JioMart
 





 • Shopify / D2C orders
 





 • Other e\-commerce channels as required Ensure marketplace orders are processed within required timelines and avoid delays or dispatch errors.
 





 \*\*4\. Offline \& Bulk Orders\*\*
 





 • Handle distributor, retailer, wholesale and other offline shipments
 





 • Prepare order\-wise picking and packing requirements
 





 • Coordinate large\-volume dispatches
 





 • Verify final quantities against invoices / orders
 





 • Coordinate transport arrangements for bulk consignments
 





 • Maintain proof of dispatch and delivery documentation
 





 \*\*5\. Stock Maintenance\*\*
 





 • Maintain accurate physical stock of finished goods
 





 • Ensure inward and outward stock movements are recorded correctly
 





 • Maintain SKU / style / colour / size\-wise stock
 





 • Conduct regular physical stock verification
 





 • Identify stock mismatches and investigate differences
 





 • Monitor damaged, returned, rejected and non\-saleable stock separately
 





 • Coordinate stock transfers between production, warehouse and dispatch
 





 • Ensure stock is stored systematically for easy identification and picking
 





 \*\*6\. Warehouse Organisation\*\*
 





 • Ensure products are stored in clearly identified locations
 





 • Maintain proper racks, bins and SKU identification
 





 • Improve picking and packing efficiency
 





 • Ensure stock is not mixed between styles, sizes or colours
 





 • Maintain cleanliness and organisation in the dispatch and stock areas
 





 • Monitor packing\-material availability
 





 • Inform management in advance when cartons, covers, labels or other materials are running low
 





 \*\*7\. Returns \& Stock Reconciliation\*\*
 





 • Receive returned shipments and verify quantities
 





 • Coordinate checking of returned products
 





 • Segregate saleable, damaged and defective returns
 





 • Ensure returned stock is correctly updated in inventory
 





 • Maintain proper records of marketplace and customer returns
 





 • Report discrepancies to the operations team / management
 





 \*\*8\. Team Handling\*\*
 





 • Allocate work to picking, packing and dispatch staff
 





 • Monitor daily productivity and pending orders
 





 • Ensure staff follow correct packing and stock\-handling processes
 





 • Train new warehouse / dispatch employees
 





 • Maintain discipline and accountability within the dispatch team
 





 • Coordinate closely with production, e\-commerce, accounts and operations teams
 





 \#\#\# REPORTING \& CONTROL The Dispatch Incharge should regularly track:
 





 • Orders pending for dispatch
 





 • Orders dispatched
 





 • FBA shipments pending / completed
 





 • Bulk shipments
 





 • Courier / transporter handovers
 





 • Physical stock
 





 • Stock discrepancies
 





 • Returns received
 





 • Damaged / rejected stock
 





 • Packing\-material availability Any mismatch or delay should be identified and reported quickly rather than discovered later during reconciliation.
 





 \#\#\# CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
 





 • \*\*2–7 years of experience\*\* in dispatch, warehouse, inventory or logistics operations
 





 • Experience in garments, textiles, e\-commerce or consumer products preferred
 





 • Experience handling \*\*bulk shipments and inventory\*\*
 





 • Amazon FBA / marketplace dispatch experience will be a strong advantage
 





 • Good understanding of SKU\-wise stock maintenance
 





 • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
 





 • Basic knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets
 





 • Comfortable working with invoices, shipment labels and dispatch documents
 





 • Ability to manage warehouse / packing staff
 





 • Good coordination and follow\-up skills
 





 • Ability to handle multiple dispatch priorities simultaneously
 





 • Responsible for stock accuracy and timely shipment completion
 





 \#\#\# IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who can independently take ownership of:
 





 \*\*Stock → Order → Picking → Checking → Packing → Documentation → Dispatch → Tracking → Reconciliation
 





 \*\* The person should understand that dispatch is not simply moving cartons out of the warehouse. The responsibility is to ensure:
 





 ✅ \*\*Right Product\*\* ✅ \*\*Right SKU \& Quantity\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Packing\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Documentation\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Destination\*\* ✅ \*\*On\-Time Dispatch\*\* ✅ \*\*Accurate Closing Stock\*\*
 





 \#\#\# COMPENSATION 💰 \*\*₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month
 





 \*\* Final salary will depend on:
 





 • Previous dispatch / warehouse experience
 





 • Stock\-management capability
 





 • Amazon FBA / e\-commerce experience
 





 • Bulk\-shipment handling experience
 





 • Team\-handling ability
 





 • Accuracy and independent working capability
 





 📩 \*\*TO APPLY\*\* Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume and mention:
 





 • Current Salary
 





 • Expected Salary
 





 • Notice Period
 





 • Current Location
 





 • Total Dispatch / Warehouse Experience
 





 • Amazon FBA / E\-commerce Experience
 





 • Experience handling stock and bulk shipments

title: Production Supervisor - Textiles/apparel
description:
📢
 **WE’RE HIRING: PRODUCTION SUPERVISOR – TEXTILES / APPAREL** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 🏢
 **Company:** 
 Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 🏭
 **Industry:** 
 Garments \| Knits \| Apparel Manufacturing
 



 💰
 **Salary:** 
 ₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month
 



 🧑‍💼
 **Experience:** 
 2–7 Years
 



 We are looking for an experienced and responsible
 **Production Supervisor** 
 to handle day\-to\-day garment production and ensure orders move smoothly from
 **cutting to packing and dispatch** 
 .
 



 The role requires strong follow\-up, floor coordination, quality awareness and the ability to achieve production targets on time.
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**1\. Production Follow\-up** 




 • Follow up the complete production process from
 **cutting, stitching, checking, ironing, finishing and packing** 




 • Ensure production is completed as per daily and weekly targets
 



 • Monitor order status and identify delays at each stage
 



 • Coordinate with production units and workers to ensure timely completion
 



 • Follow up outsourced / job\-work production when required
 



 • Ensure priority orders are completed according to delivery schedules
 



**2\. Cutting \& Stitching Coordination** 




 • Ensure fabric and cutting requirements are ready before production
 



 • Follow up cutting quantities against order requirements
 



 • Coordinate stitching production and monitor output
 



 • Identify bottlenecks and take corrective action
 



 • Ensure correct styles, sizes and colours are being produced
 



**3\. Quality Control** 




 • Ensure garments meet required quality standards
 



 • Monitor stitching quality, measurements, finishing and workmanship
 



 • Identify recurring defects and coordinate corrective action
 



 • Reduce rejection, alteration and rework
 



 • Ensure final checked quantities are ready before packing
 



**4\. Sampling \& New Production** 




 • Follow up development and production samples
 



 • Coordinate sample requirements with concerned teams
 



 • Ensure approved specifications are followed during bulk production
 



 • Highlight production feasibility issues before bulk manufacturing
 



**5\. Manpower \& Floor Management** 




 • Allocate work according to production priorities
 



 • Monitor worker productivity and output
 



 • Coordinate with supervisors, tailors, checkers, helpers and packing teams
 



 • Maintain discipline and smooth workflow on the production floor
 



 • Identify manpower shortages and inform management
 



**6\. Stock \& Material Coordination** 




 • Coordinate fabric, trims, labels, elastic, packing materials and other production requirements
 



 • Ensure materials are available before production begins
 



 • Monitor work\-in\-progress quantities
 



 • Help maintain accurate production and stock records
 



 • Report material shortages or excesses promptly
 



**7\. Packing \& Dispatch Coordination** 




 • Ensure finished garments are checked, packed and ready on schedule
 



 • Coordinate packing according to order requirements
 



 • Verify quantities before dispatch
 



 • Work closely with warehouse and dispatch teams
 



 • Ensure orders are handed over without unnecessary production delays
 


 CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
 
 •
 **2–7 years of experience** 
 in garment / textile production
 



 • Good knowledge of knitwear or apparel manufacturing processes
 



 • Strong understanding of cutting, stitching, checking, finishing and packing
 



 • Ability to follow production targets and delivery schedules
 



 • Good manpower\-handling and communication skills
 



 • Strong production follow\-up ability
 



 • Basic knowledge of production records and Excel / Google Sheets preferred
 



 • Ability to identify production problems and solve them quickly
 



 • Experience in Tirupur garment manufacturing environment will be an advantage
 


 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 
 We are looking for someone who can take ownership of:
 



**Order Planning → Cutting → Stitching → Quality → Finishing → Packing → Dispatch** 




 The candidate should be comfortable working on the production floor, continuously following up with teams and ensuring that orders are completed
 **on time, in the right quantity and with the required quality** 
 .
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 💰
 **₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month** 




 Final salary will depend on experience, garment production knowledge, manpower\-handling ability and previous responsibilities.
 



 📩
 **To Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume and mention:
 



 • Current Salary
 



 • Expected Salary
 



 • Notice Period
 



 • Current Location
 



 • Total Garment Production Experience
 



 • Current / Previous Responsibilities
